name: Hockenheimring
notes: Grand Prix circuit since 2002 (clockwise): Nordkurve, Parabolika, Spitzkehre, Mercedes-Tribuene, Motodrom. Raceway loop over the members of OSM relation 284588 (Hockenheimring Grand Prix Circuit); the 1932-2001 forest loop is only mapped as abandoned:highway=raceway and is not used. 42 laps at the opener, 41 at the finale; the spec uses 42. Traced 4517 m vs 4574 m.
